card.label: Card plan as is
card.desc: Every pass. Market buy. 50% sells at 2x, 40% at 3x, 10% trails 40%. Stop under the 2-hour low, or 30%.

entry_limit.label: Entry plan only, limit buy
entry_limit.desc: Only passes with a suggested entry. Limit buy at support, good for 12 hours. Card exits.

entry_market.label: Entry plan only, market buy
entry_market.desc: Only passes with a suggested entry, but bought at once. Card exits.

nochase.label: No chasers
nochase.desc: Skips coins up 50%+ in the last 2 hours or falling in the last hour. Market buy. 50% at 1.5x, 40% at 2x, 10% trails 30%.

freshdip.label: Fresh dip
freshdip.desc: Fresh graduates with a suggested entry. Limit buy at support. Sell all at 1.5x, stop 25%, out after 6 hours.

quick.label: Quick flip
quick.desc: Every pass. Market buy. Sell all at 1.5x, stop 25%, out after 4 hours.

big.label: Big coins (unproven)
big.desc: Safe coins the scanner rejects only for a market cap over $5M. Market buy. 50% at 1.3x, 50% at 1.5x, stop 15%, out after 48 hours.

surv_quick.label: Survivor quick
surv_quick.desc: Coins that already lasted 6 to 48 hours and held up. Market buy. Sell all at 1.25x, stop 15%, out after 12 hours.

surv_swing.label: Survivor swing
surv_swing.desc: The same coins. Market buy. 50% sells at 1.5x, 30% at 2x, 20% trails 30%. Stop 25%, out after 48 hours.

curve_run.label: Curve run
curve_run.desc: Coins still on the pump.fun curve, 30-80% full. Market buy. Sell all at the price the curve has when 90% full, stop 30%, out after 90 minutes.

curve_quick.label: Curve quick
curve_quick.desc: The same curve coins. Market buy. Sell all at 1.5x, stop 25%, out after 30 minutes.
